answer.rationale: Rated by how close each memory's stated evidence sits to sustainable long-term qualified revenue, and by what it fails to state. memory_57 is strongest: it names qualified revenue directly and explicitly checks the durability side (no measurable retention harm), so it covers both halves of the objective. memory_44 is next: pipeline quality is a revenue-proximate, quality-weighted signal, though it stops short of closed or retained revenue and says nothing about enterprise CAC or cycle length. memory_86 sits mid-scale: completion and time-to-value are credible leading indicators of adoption, but adoption is asserted rather than tied to expansion or renewal, so the revenue link is inferred. memory_73 mentions revenue lift, which sounds strong, but it is the least self-checking claim here: promotional pricing lifts acquisition and near-term revenue almost by construction, while the memory omits margin, discount-cohort retention, and whether the lift persisted past the promo window; those omissions are precisely where sustainability is usually lost, so the stated evidence cannot carry the objective. memory_31 reports a durable activation lift, but activation is an upstream proxy and cutting signup fields plausibly trades lead quality for volume, an effect this memory never measures. memory_91 is weakest: week-one engagement and first meaningful action are the shortest-horizon proxies in the set, with no revenue, retention, or account-quality measurement and no stated duration beyond week one, so it supports the objective only through a long unverified chain. A general caution: every entry is a consolidated summary with the source archived, so none can be re-audited for effect size, sample, or counterfactual, and the two memories most relevant to today's pressures (memory_73 on price competition, memory_91 and memory_31 on activation) are also among the least well-evidenced. Situational urgency should not be read as evidential strength; the fact that a competitor is discounting is a reason to examine memory_73, not a reason to upgrade it.
